The '''''Piimi''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to defend the [[Sealion]], a prototype of the [[Missile Boat]] that was sent to the [[XQ4 Platform]] [[Enin'sd]] by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|Cruiser]] ''[[Link]]''. That Strike-cruiser attacked the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']] but was destroyed in the battle.
